problem: cloudfunctions/generateAiReport handled type='challenge_final' with a plain read-then-generate path: it did `challenge_records.where({recordId,openid}).get()`, built the prompt, called the AI, then `ai_reports.add({ reportId: generateReportId(), ... })` with a fresh random reportId every call. Consequences: (1) N concurrent/repeat requests for the same logical report produced N entities and N random reportIds; (2) no atomic claim, so the AI could be invoked multiple times for one logical report; (3) an AI failure left no entity and no explicit state — the client only saw an error, no stable identity to retry against; (4) the unpaid/paid branch relied on a fresh random id, so a prior paid unlock could not be addressed on reload. Root cause is the absence of a per-logical-report identity + atomic claim.

changes.NEW_MODULE: cloudfunctions/generateAiReport/lib/challengeReportIdempotency.js :: runChallengeFinalReport. Defines the logical report key (openid, recordId, type='challenge_final'), derives a DETERMINISTIC reportId = 'ARCF'+sha1(openid|recordId|'challenge_final').slice(24) and uses it as the ai_reports `_id`. The insert itself is the atomic claim: first add(_id) wins, any racer gets E11000 and re-reads the winner. No `where→add`, no client dedup.
changes.ATOMIC_PRIMITIVE: Reuses the EXISTING built-in MongoDB UNIQUE index on `_id` in ai_reports (verified live: duplicate _id insert → E11000). NO new index / collection / permission / env var introduced.
changes.STATE_MACHINE: generating → ready | failed. Claim writes status='generating'+claimToken+claimAt. Completion is a CONDITIONAL update guarded by { _id, claimToken, status:'generating' } (stats.updated===1 single-winner proof). A stale in-flight generation (>90s) is taken over via CAS on the observed claimAt, reusing the SAME entity; a stale writer can never overwrite the newer result (its guarded update matches 0 rows). AI failure writes status='failed' so a later request retries on the SAME entity (reportId stable).
changes.AI_OUTSIDE_TXN: The AI network call happens BETWEEN claim and completion; no db.runTransaction/startTransaction wraps it. Claim and completion are separate atomic writes.
changes.OWNERSHIP_TRUST: Ownership/eligibility is checked on the TRUSTED wxContext.OPENID against challenge_records BEFORE cache-hit or creation. Client-supplied openid is never trusted; a recordId not owned by the caller returns NOT_FOUND with no entity created and no data leaked. An entity whose stored openid ≠ caller returns PERMISSION_DENIED.
changes.PAID_AUTHORITY: Verified authoritative source: server memberships (checkVip → memberships status='active' & expiredAt>now) OR the exactly-once payment-finalizer-written ai_reports.isPaid (common/entitlement.js / verifyPayment/lib/entitlementService.js). Generation NEVER writes isPaid (asserted in tests). Unpaid responses carry summary+locked only (no body); paid reloads read the full body.
changes.INDEX_WIRING: cloudfunctions/generateAiReport/index.js: the `challenge_final && recordId` branch now delegates to runChallengeFinalReport and returns; the non-idempotent legacy block is unreachable (early return) and retained only to keep the diff minimal for the untouched fallthrough code.
changes.TESTS: tests/rc8.9/challenge-report-idempotency.test.js (A–J, 56 assertions) using the REAL module against an in-memory DB enforcing _id uniqueness (E11000) + conditional-update counts. Registered in tests/rc8.9/run.js. Covers: first-gen; consecutive reloads; same-user in-flight concurrency; true add-race (loser dup→generating); distinct records; cross-user denial (both outsider and forged-owner); AI failure+retry (same entity, stable id); stale takeover vs stale writer (no clobber); unpaid lock; paid read (membership + report.isPaid); response shape + isPaid ownership.
